metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds one Romeo rehearsal, one dinner, Egeon's margin, and Cowley's roll.

yesterday: The cup was run once, under the note. Saturday's Nurse is still to come.
Cowley's clean roll is Benvolio's cues, with the blot lifted.
The loaf is two fingers short and still a penny. Dinner was 3d. Alse asked after Saturday, and you made no promise.
The meal went on the slate. The firing stays the weekly sixpence.
